faq.a: No, bank holidays are often state-specific, depending on local festivals and regional observances, in addition to a few national holidays.

faq.q: Can I still use UPI during a bank holiday?
faq.a: Yes, UPI (Unified Payments Interface) operates 24/7, 365 days a year, including on bank holidays, allowing for instant fund transfers.

faq.q: What happens to my cheque if I deposit it on a bank holiday?
faq.a: If you deposit a cheque on a bank holiday, its processing and clearance will only commence on the next working day.

faq.q: Are online fund transfers like NEFT/RTGS affected?
faq.a: While NEFT and RTGS systems operate 24/7, 365 days a year, the final credit to the beneficiary's account might see minor delays if the receiving bank's internal systems require manual intervention on a holiday.

faq.q: Do bank holidays affect credit card payments or loan EMIs?
faq.a: Credit card payments and loan EMIs are typically due on specific dates. If the due date falls on a bank holiday, you should ensure funds are available in your account, as auto-debits usually proceed. It is always best to make payments in advance to avoid any late fees.

faq.q: Where can I find the official list of bank holidays?
faq.a: The official list of bank holidays is published annually by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on its website, categorised by state.
